edges.description: The dangling pointer left in der->value (= obj->content.value) after the premature free(der->value) at pkcs15-pubkey.c:315 propagates unchanged through the caller's cleanup path to sc_pkcs15_free_object_content at pkcs15.c:2536, where it is freed a second time.

root_cause_criterion.description: After the error handler calls free(der->value) at line 315, the pointer must not also be freed by the caller's cleanup (sc_pkcs15_free_object_content). The fix (commit 5557f34) removes the premature free entirely, so __gt_prior_free_ptr stays NULL and the cleanup_free assertion sees content_value != prior_free_ptr.
